title: Asset context frame
description: Hyperliquid's `activeAssetCtx` for one perp as the adapter publishes it: the mark (the price native triggers fire on), the venue's mid (null when a side of the book is empty), the oracle (the index price), the day's notional volume and the hourly funding rate. The venue stamps no time on it: its age is our receipt time. Also the data of the panel socket's `asset-ctx/<instrumentId>` topic (the trade screen's price header). Mirrors src/domain/marketdata/frames.ts (AssetCtxFrame).

instrument.description: The venue's coin name, with the dex prefix on HIP-3.

dayNtlVlm.description: Notional volume over the last 24 hours, in the collateral token.

funding.description: The current hourly funding rate as a signed fraction ("0.0000125" is 0.00125 % an hour): positive, longs pay shorts.

decimal.description: A plain non-negative decimal string. Never a JSON number.
